title: fix(service-automation): get_record form descriptor's limit declares minimum 1
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuACdPWFJTLDcTrByFCHLzqb)_

Fixes #25361

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

The `get_record` node's `limit` is a positive integer in the contract (`GetRecordConfigSchema.limit`, `z.number().int().positive()`, narrowed by PR #25357), so every flow save door refuses `0`, a negative or a fraction. The executor's form descriptor in `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/crud-nodes.ts` still declared `limit: { type: 'integer', title: 'Limit' }`, so the designer form offered values the save always refuses.

- The descriptor's `limit` now declares `minimum: 1`, the contract's floor.
- Landing: the claimed file, `builtin/crud-nodes.ts`. No `packages/spec` edit, no `engine.ts` edit.
- Derivation was considered: no node descriptor in `builtin/` is derived from its spec Zod today. Every descriptor is a hand-written literal, and the bounded siblings (`loop.maxIterations`, `try_catch.retry.*`) declare `minimum`/`maximum` by hand, so this follows that pattern.

## Pin

`builtin-node-form-zod-ledger.test.ts` gains `get_record.limit: the form's minimum is the contract's refusal boundary`. It reads the descriptor's `limit.minimum` (asserts `1`), then parses `GetRecordConfigSchema` at that boundary: the minimum is accepted, one below it is refused, and `0` is refused. Neither side can move alone.

## Measurement: other `builtin/` descriptors against their contracts

Every numeric property in `builtin/` descriptors was compared with its spec Zod at this tree:

| Descriptor key | Descriptor | Contract | Agree |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `get_record.limit` | integer, now `minimum: 1` | `int().positive()` | yes (this PR) |
| `loop.maxIterations` | integer, `minimum: 1`, `maximum: LOOP_MAX_ITERATIONS_CEILING` | `int().min(1).max(LOOP_MAX_ITERATIONS_CEILING)` | yes |
| `try_catch.retry.maxRetries` | integer 0..10 | `int().min(0).max(10)` | yes |
| `try_catch.retry.backoffMs` / `maxRetryDelayMs` | integer, `minimum: 0` | `int().min(0)` | yes |
| `try_catch.retry.backoffMultiplier` | number, `minimum: 1` | `min(1)` | yes |
| `http.timeoutMs` | number | `z.number()` (unbounded) | yes |
| `screen.fields[].min` / `max` | number | `z.number()` (unbounded) | yes |

No other mismatch was found.

## Verification (head `21ecd5680e`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 198 passed (198), Tests 2619 passed (2619).
- Ablation (committed fix first, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the anchor `minimum: 1` was removed (anchor 1 to 0, blob `b7d8ec771a76` to `5c181206f838`). The new pin went red: `AssertionError: expected undefined to be 1`, 1 failed and 9 passed. The file was restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `crud-nodes.js` from `src`, so no `dist/` hop is involved.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 67): 66 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (no full-repo `dist/`), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and is left to CI.
